scope: Passive registered-cloud recorder only; no navigation or physical-control change
actual_source: /cloud_registered_full original ROS PointCloud2 x/y/z fields, skip_nans=true

waiting_cache.payload: Actual decoded XYZ array, original dtype/shape and immutable copied original header/frame/received-monotonic-wall/raw-payload-SHA metadata
waiting_cache.eviction: Only source-stamp age>1s is normally evicted; frame/byte overflow inside the retained span fails explicitly
waiting_cache.duplicates: Same stamp with same raw SHA is deduplicated; same stamp different raw SHA or backwards source stamp fails explicitly

flush: At the first passive observer tick or registered-cloud callback seeing actual mover state entering/blocking/leaving/clear, archive the cached actual arrays in source order using cloud_ORIGINAL_INTEGER_STAMP.npz and append pre_roll sensor-input rows. Original source stamp and received wall are never changed; flush-state/time are separate fields.
phase_behavior: Original active entering/blocking/leaving and clear+5sim-second evidence conditions remain; no old run receives reconstructed or new data

metadata.archive_kind: pre_roll or active; archive_duplicate marks a same-original-payload reference
metadata.decoded_xyz_sha256: SHA256 of original decoded array C-order bytes; distinct from raw PointCloud2 data SHA and native filtered-float64 SHA
metadata.pre_roll_flush_fixture_phase: Actual observed mover phase at passive flush
metadata.pre_roll_flush_fixture_sim_time: Observed phase-source time, not original acquisition stamp
metadata.pre_roll_flush_monotonic_wall: Actual flush callback clock, not original receive clock

final_manifest: dynamic_sensor_evidence_manifest.json schema2 records pre-roll limits/counters/error, unique archived XYZ count, drained writer error and actual NPZ/JPG SHA list. Overflow, conflict, backward stamps or queue errors must remain failed evidence.
unchanged: V44 controller/profile/heading/guard/TTL/arrival/parking/fixture/physics/model unchanged; candidate5 requires original strict complete actual coverage
